brief.objective: Minimize closest_lady_distance^2 + 1e6/(closest_guard_distance+0.1) within 240 s, ideally reaching the 5 m Lady win radius. Lady miss distance is the dominant cost term: 500 m of miss costs 2.5e5, while a 20 m Guard pass costs only 5e4. Pressing toward the Lady is mandatory, and the Guard only needs to be kept outside capture range plus a margin.
brief.approach: Start immediately with a fast along-track run toward the Lady, offset radially (aim around x = -250 to -350 m, below the Guard's line) so the run bypasses the Guard rather than meeting it head-on; use GO_TO_WAYPOINT with waypoints that arc around the Guard's side. Keep a high closing speed so the Guard has little time to re-aim. Trigger EVADE_GUARD only when the Guard is inside the keepout and closing, then sidestep around it toward the Lady and resume APPROACH_LADY at once rather than retreating. Once past the Guard, glide-slope in with APPROACH_LADY and brake late; avoid long chases that waste delta-v, and never stop to hold while the Guard is nearby.
phases: T0-20s: accelerate along-track toward the Lady while building a radial offset (x about -300 m) to sidestep the Guard's line
Bypass: fly offset waypoints past the Guard at max closing speed; EVADE_GUARD only if the Guard is within 150 m and closing, sidestepping toward the Lady
Run-in: once the Guard is behind or abeam, APPROACH_LADY on the braking glide slope, recentering x toward 0
Terminal: final approach at 2 m/s or less to within 5 m of the Lady; BRAKE only if overshooting
Contingency: if delta-v nears the reserve or the Guard pins the Bandit, take the closest reachable Lady distance while keeping the Guard above about 30 m; COAST to save fuel when no thrust is needed

goal.rationale: The Guard sits on the direct line at y=-600 m, so route the Bandit radially outboard to x=-300 m and pass it at high closing speed, then re-target the Lady once abeam.
